beats.summary: Michael announces the cancellation of the drug testing and proposes a visual inspection instead, which Dwight disputes.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Okay, attention everyone the drug testing has been cancelled. Instead, I will be going around to each of you and doing a visual inspection.
Dwight: No you can't do that.

beats.summary: Dwight questions Kevin and Angela about prescription drug use.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Kevin, what prescription drugs are you taking, besides Rogaine?
Angela: I don't take any prescription drugs.

beats.summary: Kelly tries to impress Jim by talking about her dress and nervousness, while Jim reacts with mixed signals.

evidence.snippet: Kelly: So the first time we went out to dinner, it was like, whatever, fine, but I was so nervous.
[STAGE] Jim hunches his shoulders and grins

beats.summary: Michael accuses the office of not taking drug use seriously and reveals that his earlier joke about Dwight being a narc was a test everyone failed.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: You were the one joking around calling Dwight a narc.

beats.summary: Michael lectures about the dangers of drugs and insists on drug testing, singling out Toby for additional tests.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Drugs ruin lives people. Drugs destroy careers.

beats.summary: Jim is encouraged to share a personal story about drugs but ultimately refuses to do so.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I know that Jim has an amazing story about a relative of his who got caught up in the world of drugs.
[STAGE] Jim pretends to try, looking teary eyed, shakes his head no, mouths "I can't" and sits back down.
